card.title: Call It a Fair Win
card.instruction: Get them to recognize the result as deserved rather than accidental, gifted, or manipulated.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say I earned the quiz trophy, not that the questions suited me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There were a lot of bird questions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I spent six months learning birds. That's preparation with feathers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You were lucky they asked them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And the birds were lucky I was ready. Now call it earned.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 demands earned credit; A3 cites study; A5 repeats the earned verdict.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 plausibly distinguish specialized knowledge from fortunate question selection.
